name: Spirit Binding, Lesser
body:
School conjuration (calling) [see text]; Level druid 5, shaman 5, witch 5

Casting Time 10 minutes

Components V, S

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels); see text

Target one elemental or outsider with 6 HD or less

Duration instantaneous

Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance no and yes; see text

This spell functions as lesser planar binding, except it can bind any outsider, fey, or incorporeal undead.
